questions.learningObjective: Analyze how alternative text applies in a computing setting.

options.misconception: Confuses alternative text with search captions

questions.hint: How does a blind user learn what an image shows?

questions.stem: A classroom exercise presents 2081 users to teach cultural bias. Which statement about cultural bias does this account support?

options.text: Equal design for all cultures always

questions.explanation: cultural bias: Cultural bias in design happens when a system reflects the assumptions of one culture and excludes or misrepresents others. With 2081 users in view, that principle distinguishes the correct choice; every other option rests on a specific misconception.
questions.hint: Whose assumptions are built into the default?
